ruleDefinitions.name: Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity Disabled
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects changes to the HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity registry key and the "Enabled" value being set to 0 in order to disable the Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity feature. This allows an attacker to load unsigned and untrusted code to be run in the kernel
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\DeviceGuard\\\\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\DeviceGuard\\\\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\DeviceGuard\\\\Scenarios\\\\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\\\\Enabled$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")
